verdict.rationale: Signifyd's docs show a broad REST API covering core workflows (sale/checkout events, decisions, chargebacks, guarantees, webhooks, sensitive-data handling) suggesting strong programmatic access, but there is no evidence explicitly confirming full parity with all UI/dashboard capabilities (e.g., reporting, account/team management, analytics views referenced only on marketing pages). Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or evidence that all dashboard features (reporting, account config, chargeback recovery dashboards) are API-accessible, and independent confirmation of completeness.
